correctness.rationale: The degree-5 endpoint defect was derived exactly from normalized Jacobi formulas, the Chebyshev endpoint case was checked directly, and the central-value gamma formula proves unbounded-below behavior for -1<alpha<-1/2. These cover all alpha<0 and combine with the cited alpha>=0 theorem.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. Searches around the new source theorem and equivalent lower-envelope terminology found no prior negative-parameter sharpness classification, while classical identities used as ingredients are expressly not claimed as new.

value.rationale: The finding gives the exact maximal Jacobi parameter range of a new lower-envelope theorem and identifies explicit, qualitatively distinct failure mechanisms immediately below zero, at the Chebyshev threshold, and below it.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, formal verification, or a guarantee of first discovery.
